description: First flew April 1975; stored at Shawbury, then displayed at the Directorate of Army Aviation, Middle Wallop, restored at Wattisham and now used as a recruiting aid at Blenheim Camp. Inside the camp perimeter. Last recorded present September 2025.
museum_name: Blenheim Camp Aircraft Display, Bury St Edmunds

description: Withdrawn at Middle Wallop in February 2018 and de-registered that October; held indoors at Blenheim Camp as an instructional airframe. Not visible from outside the camp. Last recorded present April 2021.
museum_name: Blenheim Camp Aircraft Display, Bury St Edmunds
